salon_info.name: Razors-n-scissors
salon_info.address: BH-5, Lovely Professional University Campus, Phagwara, Punjab

policies.cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 1 hour before scheduled appointment time.
policies.walk_in_policy: Walk-ins are welcome, but pre-booked appointments have priority.

faqs.question: What are your opening hours?
faqs.answer: We are open every day (Monday to Sunday) from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM.

faqs.question: Where is the salon located?
faqs.answer: We are at BH-5, Lovely Professional University Campus, Phagwara, Punjab. Look for the Razors-n-scissors board!

faqs.question: How much does a haircut cost?
faqs.answer: A standard Hair Cut is just ₹100. Head Wash is ₹50 extra. For a combo of Hair Colour & Hair Cut it's ₹500.

faqs.question: What services do you offer?
faqs.answer: We offer Hair Cut (₹100), Head Wash (₹50), Head Shave (₹120), Beard Trim/Gaming Shave (₹50), Head Massage (₹100), Head Massage with Olive/Almond Oil (₹150), Face Bleach (₹180), D Tan Cleaner (₹300), D Tan Facial (₹450), Gold/Diamond Facial with Oxy Bleach (₹700), Whitening Facial (₹600), Keratin Hair Spa (₹400), Loreal Matrix Hair Spa (₹500), Hair Colour (₹450), Hair Colour & Hair Cut (₹500), Anti Dandruff Treatment for 3 seatings (₹1500).

faqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: Just message us here on WhatsApp or Telegram! Tell us the service you want and your preferred time and we will confirm your slot.

faqs.question: How do I cancel or reschedule?
faqs.answer: Type 'cancel my appointment' or your phone number and we will handle it right away. Free cancellations up to 1 hour before your slot.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept Cash and all UPI apps (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm).

faqs.question: What are your salient features?
faqs.answer: 1. Maintenance of hygiene  2. Professionally trained staff  3. Pocket friendly rates

faqs.question: How much does beard trim cost?
What facial options do you have?
faqs.answer: We have Face Bleach (₹180), D Tan Cleaner (₹300), D Tan Facial (₹450), Gold/Diamond Facial with Oxy Bleach (₹700), and Whitening Facial (₹600).

faqs.question: What hair spa treatments do you offer?
faqs.answer: We offer Keratin Hair Spa (₹400) and Loreal Matrix Hair Spa (₹500).

faqs.question: Do you treat dandruff?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our Anti Dandruff Treatment is a course of 3 seatings priced at ₹1500 total.

faqs.question: What is the contact number?
faqs.answer: For any enquiry call or WhatsApp us at +91 6284421638.
